# Subsonic Society
> Precision Is In Our DNA. Competition • Testing • Education • Community
> The premier precision rimfire competition series, ballistics testing laboratory, and marksman fraternity in the United States.

## Platform Summary
- **Organization**: Subsonic Society
- **Headquarters**: Bristol, Tennessee (Appalachian Mountain High Country)
- **Flagship Facility**: The Hideout (Elevation: 3,420 FT, Holston Mountain Ridgeline)
- **Primary Sport**: Precision Rimfire Rifle Shooting (.22 LR standard velocity)
- **Marquee Championship**: The Subsonic Society Invitational ($7,500 Guaranteed Cash Purse presented by Modacam Custom Rifles)
- **Official Website**: https://subsonicsociety.com
- **Contact**: contact@subsonicsociety.com | Bristol, TN

## Core Pillars
1. **Competition Without Gatekeeping**: High-stakes, 18-stage matches on technical reactive steel from 25 yards to 465 yards. Equal access for grassroots club competitors and national pro marksmen across Open, Production, Senior, Ladies, and Youth divisions.
2. **Subsonic DNA Ballistic Testing**: Independent, empirical chronograph velocity data (SD/ES), 50y/100y/300y group dispersion, harmonic tuner benchmarks (Harrell, EC Tuner, PVA), and high-altitude density altitude DOPE tables.
3. **Education & Mentorship**: Free open-source DOPE cards, wind-reading masterclasses in mountain canyon thermals, positional barricade mechanics, and competitor debriefs.
4. **Authentic Community**: 100% free digital membership with instant credential minting, decentralized tactical comms network, and sportsmanship code of conduct.

## Ammunition & Competition Regulations
- **Permitted Ammunition**: .22 Long Rifle standard velocity only (< 1,120 FPS muzzle velocity). Hyper-velocity ammunition (> 1,120 FPS) is strictly prohibited on steel targets.
- **Match Divisions**:
  - Open Pro: Custom actions (Vudoo V-22, RimX, Anschütz), custom barrels, any optic, harmonic tuners allowed.
  - Production: Factory rifles under $1,200 MSRP (CZ 457, Tikka T1x, Ruger Precision Rimfire) with optic under $1,000 MSRP.
  - Senior (55+), Ladies, and Youth (<18).
- **Targetry**: AR500 and AR550 reactive steel hanging plates, KYL (Know Your Limits) racks, hostage flappers, and 300–465 yard long-gong targets.
